verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The Archimedean dichotomy and character representation are established with the required normalization and uniqueness; the finite-type compactness argument for characters is valid for nets; the fixed-type Philippon measure is finite, continuous, homogeneous, conjugation-invariant, and uniformly within O(1) of the maximum coefficient logarithm; and the main estimate |Phi-M|<=C rho proves continuity across the Archimedean/non-Archimedean boundary. The nowhere-zero hypothesis ensures all logarithmic values are finite, and homogeneity gives the stated line-bundle frame-change rule. The D'Andrea-Krick-Sombra and Zhang references were checked against their precise definitions, formulas, hypotheses, and downstream uses and are applicable.
